d: Goodman Masson is partnering with a new financial markets venture under formation in Oman. Backed by prominent institutional investors, the business is building its operations from the ground up and is now hiring during the build phase.
This is an opportunity to join at an early stage and help establish the secure, resilient and highly available technology infrastructure required to support critical business operations.

The Senior Infrastructure / Cloud Engineer will be responsible for designing, managing and securing the organisation’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure. This includes cloud platforms, servers, storage, networking, virtualisation and containerised environments, ensuring systems remain reliable, secure and available.

Reporting to the Head of IT Infrastructure, you will also provide technical leadership and day-to-day supervision to assigned Infrastructure Team Members, coordinating tasks, resolving complex technical issues and supporting the ongoing development of the infrastructure environment.
q: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
At least five years’ experience in infrastructure and/or cloud engineering .
Strong hands-on experience managing cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments.
Sound knowledge of server administration, networking, firewalls, VPNs, backup, disaster recovery and high availability.
Experience with infrastructure security, patching, access controls and incident management.
Working proficiency in relevant technologies, including OCI, Azure, AWS, VMware, Hyper-V, Windows and Linux.
Familiarity with containerisation and infrastructure automation tools, including Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell and Python.
Experience supervising, mentoring or guiding technical team members.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed when resolving critical production incidents.
Excellent communication, documentation and prioritisation skills.
Relevant professional certifications in cloud, infrastructure or networking technologies.
Experience supporting business-critical or highly available production environments.
Experience coordinating infrastructure projects and working with external technology vendors.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in building the technology foundations of a new financial markets venture, combining hands-on engineering with technical leadership as the business develops.
r: li
Manage cloud infrastructure across OCI, Azure and AWS, alongside servers, storage and virtualisation platforms including VMware and Hyper-V.
li
Administer Windows and Linux servers, enterprise infrastructure services and containerised environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
li
Automate infrastructure deployment, configuration and maintenance using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell and Python.
li
Support networking, firewalls, VPNs and cloud connectivity to maintain secure and reliable infrastructure services.
li
Manage backup, disaster recovery, monitoring and high-availability solutions to support business continuity.
li
Implement infrastructure security measures, patching, access controls and relevant compliance requirements.
li
Troubleshoot and resolve incidents affecting critical production systems, escalating significant risks and incidents where appropriate.
li
Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures and infrastructure diagrams.
li
Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of assigned Infrastructure Team Members, providing technical guidance and monitoring task completion.
li
Coordinate with internal IT teams, cloud providers, technology vendors and service providers on support, maintenance and project delivery.

d: Senior Teaching Fellow: Computer Science/Software Engineering (Bahrain) (680250)
University of Strathclyde, Bahrain (Work location: Manama, Bahrain)

Be part of a vibrant community that celebrates over 200 years of academic excellence, world-class research, and impactful innovation. Located in the dynamic Bahrain Bay, the University of Strathclyde, Bahrain, offers the same high standards of academic excellence and pioneering research that our Glasgow, UK campus is renowned for.

We currently provide eight undergraduate programmes in Engineering, Science, and Business, with future phases set to expand our offerings in research and innovation. As a leading international technological university, our mission, inspired by our founding principle as ‘a place of useful learning,’ is to make a positive difference in the lives of our students, society, and the world.

Since 1995, we have been delivering MBA teaching at our international centre in Bahrain. Now, in partnership with S Eleven Educational, we are proud to expand our activities to create an Innovation, Research, and Education Hub.

Based within the Faculty of Science, the Department of Computer & Information Sciences is an internationally recognised research department specialising in information science, artificial intelligence, computer security, health informatics, interactive systems, and theoretical computer science. It is home to around 900 undergraduates, taught postgraduate and PhD students with an increasing emphasis on in-person and online delivery of high-quality educational programmes. The Department has a large portfolio of undergraduate and postgraduate taught programmes ranging from Computer Science/Software Engineering to more specialist programmes in areas such as Digital Health Systems, Cyber Security and Artificial Intelligence.

You will play a central role in leading the design and delivery of our BSc (Hons) Computer Science and BSc (Hons) Software Engineering programmes on our Bahrain campus. We would love to hear from you if you have a good knowledge of computer science/software engineering, as you will be expected to design/develop course materials, teach those programmes and guide more junior colleagues. Experience of teaching in one or more of the following areas is required:
Programming (e.g. Java, Python, Haskell, C, PHP, JavaScript, SQL, and covering data structures and algorithms, concurrency, software architecture, design patterns)
Theoretical computer science including quantitative methods (mathematical underpinnings), logic and complexity analysis
Computer architecture and low-level assembly-language programming
Professional issues in computing (ethics, regulatory frameworks such as data protection, etc)
Knowledge of and the ability to teach current practices/frameworks/tools used as part of software engineering within industry
The use of technology within business

You will be expected to have a good Honours degree and a PhD in a relevant area, to enable you to lead the delivery of the Bahrain programmes and provide student support. You will also be expected to develop your knowledge of appropriate teaching methods and good pedagogic practice.

The University of Strathclyde, Bahrain is a socially progressive institution that strives to ensure equality of opportunity and celebrates the diversity of its student and staff community. Strathclyde is people-oriented and collaborative, offering a supportive working culture with a deep commitment to equality and diversity.
We strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including women, minorities, and individuals with disabilities.
Informal enquiries about the post can be directed to Martin Halvey, Head of Department, Computer and Information Sciences (martin.halvey@strath.ac.uk).
Please note: Applicants who have previously submitted their candidacy for this position are advised not to reapply.
